gold: Fibrofatty residua of involuted infantile hemangioma

selector.rationale: The presence of a skin-colored, exophytic, soft, oval tumor with overlying pinpoint vessels and branching telangiectasia, composed of mature adipose and fibrous tissues, best matches the characteristics of Nevus lipomatosus superficialis

rejected.label: Fibrolipoma
rejected.why: Lower score and less specific match to the clinical and histological findings

rejected.label: Lipofibromatosis
rejected.why: Although it has a higher score, the specific characteristics of the tumor and its composition are more closely aligned with Nevus lipomatosus superficialis
